title: Lessons for Pentagon Procurement from the Special Operations Enterprise
gist: Cogs of War podcast notes: as the Pentagon races to buy hundreds of thousands of unmanned systems, acquisition officials are borrowing fast commercial-tech buying methods from the special operations community. SOF CTO Cara Teeter and unmanned-systems acquisition lead Bonnie Evangelista discuss competitions, marketplaces, this summer's first accelerator event, Project Agincourt, the new Autonomous Warfare Command and the Defense Autonomous Warfare Group.
